title: Ya-Sin 36:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 11 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 11. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: يسٓ (١) وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ (٢) إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ (٣) عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ (٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Izhar of the noon of seen before و (Hafs)

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:1-4 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:1-4 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: In Hafs, the noon of «يسٓ» before «وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ» is ...
Listening rota: today's group recites 36:1-4 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, explain what 'a straight path' means for a Muslim today.
questions.a: Following the Qur'an and Sunnah: tawheed, worship and good character without going astray.

questions.q: Explain why يسٓ has a 6-count madd on seen.
questions.a: The letter name سين has a madd letter followed by a sakin noon: madd lazim harfi, 6 counts.

questions.q: 36:3 to 4 tell the Prophet ﷺ that he is ...
options: among the messengers, on a straight path
questions.a: A) among the messengers, on a straight path. 36:3 to 4: 'indeed you are from among the messengers, on a straight path'.

questions.q: Think again: Ya-Sin begins with two letters, then an oath by 'the wise Qur'an'. Why might Allah swear by the Qur'an itself?
questions.a: To show its greatness and that the Prophet ﷺ is truly a messenger on a straight path (36:2 to 4).
